svg.title: SMAWK row minima: 12 by 18
svg.desc: Heatmap of matrix values. Dots mark evaluated cells; green outlines mark leftmost minima. Recursion panels show depth-local column elimination and selected rows.
svg.text: 12 rows x 18 columns | 101 evaluations | 48 comparisons | depth 4
Dot: evaluated (tooltip: visits) | Green outline: leftmost minimum
Heat: low = dark, high = light | Background rendering: 216 separate evaluations
RECURSION | red: eliminated here | blue: retained | purple: recurse | gray: inactive
